feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 699 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: 1099-NEC Vendor CSV Checker — Find Missing TINs and Who Crosses $2,000 Before You File
entry.summary: Free 1099-NEC pre-flight check: paste your vendor payments CSV and see who crosses the $600 or $2,000 threshold, missing or invalid TINs, blank addresses, bad state codes, duplicate vendors and card payments to leave out. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: BAI2 Statement Reader — Read and Check a Bank BAI2 File in Your Browser
entry.summary: Free BAI2 file viewer and checker: turns a bank's BAI2 statement into accounts, balances and a transaction list you can download as CSV, and checks the 49, 98 and 99 control totals and record counts. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

entry.title: Bank CSV to QBO Converter — Free CSV to QBO, OFX and QIF for QuickBooks
entry.summary: Free bank CSV to QBO, OFX and QIF converter for QuickBooks and Quicken: handles debit/credit columns, US and European dates and decimals, catches bad rows and duplicates, and runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

entry.title: Business Vehicle Depreciation Calculator — Section 179 vs bonus vs MACRS, heavy SUV and truck
entry.summary: Enter the vehicle price, class and business-use percentage and see the first-year deduction and tax saved under regular MACRS, 100% bonus depreciation and Section 179, with the car luxury-auto caps and the 6,000 lb SUV cap applied, plus standard mileage. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: COBRA vs Marketplace Calculator — which costs less after a job loss
entry.summary: Enter your COBRA premium and a marketplace quote and see the total cost of each over the months you need coverage, at five levels of medical care, with the break-even point and your election and special-enrollment deadlines. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: EDI X12 Order Checker — Validate 850, 810, 856 and 997 Files Before You Send
entry.summary: Free EDI X12 file checker and reader for suppliers: finds wrong SE/GE/IEA counts and control numbers, UPC and SSCC check-digit errors, invoice totals that do not match the lines and broken ship-notice hierarchies, and translates 997 rejections. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

entry.title: 835 ERA Underpayment Finder — Check Payer Payments Against Your Contract
entry.summary: Free tool for medical and dental practices: drop in an X12 835 remittance file and see which service lines paid below your contract rates, which claims were denied and why, and what the payer took back. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

entry.title: EU Bank Statement Reader — Open camt.053 and MT940 Files and Convert to CSV
entry.summary: Free camt.053 and MT940 bank statement reader: see balances and entries as a table, check that opening balance plus entries equals the closing balance, catch duplicates and gaps, and download a CSV. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

entry.title: EU VAT OSS Calculator
entry.summary: Free EU VAT OSS calculator: EUR 10,000 threshold check and the quarterly OSS return by country and rate from a sales CSV.

entry.title: Form 5500 Late Filing Calculator — DFVC Cost vs IRS and DOL Penalties
entry.summary: Free Form 5500 late filing calculator for 401(k) and retirement-plan sponsors: the due date with weekend rollover and the Form 5558 extension, days late, and the DOL DFVC programme cost beside IRS and DOL penalty exposure. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: IRS IRIS 1099 CSV Check — Find Upload Errors Before You File
entry.summary: Free IRIS 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC CSV checker: finds bad TINs, invalid SSNs, state and ZIP errors, money formats, below-threshold amounts and duplicate recipients with line numbers, and applies safe fixes. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

entry.title: NACHA File Validator — Check an ACH File Before You Send It to the Bank
entry.summary: Free ACH file checker for payroll and vendor-payment files: finds bad record lengths, routing-number check digits, wrong entry hash and control totals, missing block padding and weekend effective dates, and rebuilds the control records. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: SEPA pain.001 Validator — Check a SEPA XML Payment File Before You Upload It
entry.summary: Free SEPA XML checker for pain.001 credit transfer and pain.008 direct debit files: recomputes NbOfTxs and CtrlSum, checks IBAN and BIC, EUR, TARGET2 execution dates, field lengths and the SEPA character set, and repairs the totals. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

entry.title: SEPA pain.002 Status Reader
entry.summary: Free SEPA pain.002 reader: which payments your bank rejected, what each code (AC04, AM04, MD01) means, what to fix. In your browser.

entry.title: SEPA Payment File Validator — Check a pain.001 XML File Before You Send It to the Bank
entry.summary: Free SEPA credit transfer file checker for pain.001 XML: finds invalid IBANs, wrong NbOfTxs and CtrlSum, bad execution dates, characters the bank will reject and malformed XML, and rebuilds the control sums. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

entry.title: Shopify Product CSV Check — Find Import Errors Before You Upload
entry.summary: Free Shopify product CSV checker: finds blank handles, split products, duplicate variants, bad prices, wrong barcode check digits, broken image URLs, Excel-damaged SKUs and semicolon files, with line numbers, and applies safe fixes. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.
